title: Kevin Anton, Freudis Rojas embrace the career potential of ProBoxTV card
snippet: On a card ripe with opportunity, Kevin Anton and Freudis Rojas made weight for the Friday night ProBoxTV main event at Rawhide Events Center in nearby Chandler. Anton, 14-0 (12 KOs), of Palmdale, California, weighed 152.9lbs and Las Vegas’ Rojas, 15-1 (11 KOs), came in at 151.4lbs for the WBC Continental Americas junior-middleweight belt.
